systemic.what: tools/hbm_die_wrap.py binds every RTL port not named in a spec to the cfg shift chain (inputs) or the XOR fold / sink (outputs), drives every unclaimed die output bit 0 and ignores every unclaimed die input bit; nothing fails. This is how TA-01/02/03/13 were created silently.
systemic.fix: fail closed: a cfg / fold / const / open / spare bind must carry an explicit class (debug|test|by_design) and a reason; functional ports may not use them; the wrapper writes its ledger rows (coverage gap class TIED_OFF)

systemic.what: tools/qwen_rom_fulldie_b3r2.py Q14 drops abstract ports no die net reaches, and the spine masters have no die-view wrapper, so an RTL port without a die bus disappears instead of failing
systemic.fix: record dropped ports per master in the generator output and the coverage ledger; build die-view wrappers with explicit per-port binds

systemic.what: die_top_lint binds placeholder masters as stubs and split masters by a direction model; its "undriven" rows for hfd_index_q_b*/hfd_svc_*_s*/hfd_cmdproc_n<->s x*/hfd_attn_half_* seams come from the direction model (both ends of a derived split master unknown): verified as artefacts for cmdproc xl/xb/xt (driven by extra_out in the S/N wrappers); the svc / index_q / attn-half seams are the same class but not checked bit by bit. The lint cannot see wrapper-internal ties
systemic.fix: add the wrapper ledgers (SYS-1) to the lint input
